Growth.subject: Creative Agency-Decision Pinnacle
Growth.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I am reaching out regarding your LinkedIn post scouting for creative agencies. I  would like to take this opportunity to introduce Decision Pinnacle as a creative agency driving counterculture.

As an organisation we have had the chance to work on diverse sectors from FMCG, BPC,Apparel,Kids,GM etc. Some of the brands we have worked on include ARKS ,Sleepyhead,Superbottoms, Koparo,VI John, MyFrido,Conscious Chemist, Basil , Sadhev among others who we have helped unlock growth through creative and performance marketing expertise 

We are a full funnel partner through insight to execution, helping build brand identity, brand book, helping do catalogue, lifestyle shoots, run social media and performance marketing campaigns to aid in holistic growth. Please find attached a note on us along with some case studies for your ready reference and review.

I am also enclosing quick links to some of our recent campaigns
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZagH-hoioCFoLUo9ckAuXLnQFJQyBQkS/view?usp=sharing
